summary: Ran docs/slice-testing-strategy.md. The driver's sweep was green at Ansible bb4db40 and HelmCharts 93626fcf8e96; I ran the one gate it does not cover, DockerImages backup-server (gofmt, go vet, go test -race on go1.26.5: all green), and read the Ansible, HelmCharts and DockerImages diffs for idempotence, check-mode honesty, blast radius and serial safety. Then I pushed in the plan's order with no rebase needed: DockerImages 0af47c9 (build #2526, which rolled prd's backup-server via IaC/HelmCharts #6542); HelmCharts 2ada3db through P4 (#6543); a live gate on prd (target up, last-success non-zero, hostname serves no metrics); then P5 93626fc (#6545); Ansible bb4db40 (IaC/Build-Main #180 SUCCESS: lint, validate, plan 'No changes', protected-VM check); and AnsibleSpecs. Both rules are loaded on prd with health ok and state inactive, and no Backup* alert was ever pending or firing. 18 of 21 verification.json items are verified; V01, V05 and V19 are owed to the operator because the OpenBao wrapper on srvvault1-3 is still the old one and the first declared nightly uploads have not run yet. Operator gate (close-out A2): `cd /work/Ansible/ansible && cexec iac poetry run ansible-playbook playbooks/site-openbao.yml --tags openbao_backup --limit openbao --check`, expect changed=1 per node (the wrapper script), then the same line without --check. Blast radius is srvvault1-3 only, serial 1 on apply, no service restarts. A --tags run skips Play 0, so if the upload token was rotated since 2026-08-15, run it without --tags. The timers next fire tonight at 02:33, 02:42 and 02:52 CEST; the Postgres streams appear after the 02:00 run with no operator action, and the settle queries are in V19. No finding cleared the generation bar. The close-out gained A2, N1 and B7 (a GitHub token printed in IaC/HelmCharts build logs, pre-existing) and notes on A1 (dev has nothing to delete), B2, S3 and S4.
